title: Capture deployable architecture artifacts
goal: Turn the taxonomy, renderer/export, and deterministic-generator subagent outputs into durable implementation artifacts that move Worksheet Universe toward a deployable JSON-first worksheet compiler.
context: The public static app is pushed to GitHub and Vercel-ready. The next deployability gap is preserving the plans for standards-aligned worksheet type metadata, mixed HTML/TeX rendering, LaTeX export, and coherent deterministic generation so future implementation can proceed from repo artifacts instead of chat context.
acceptance: Taxonomy artifact documents grade, topic, skill, subskill, standards, difficulty, prerequisite, and coverage fields
Renderer artifact documents HTML/CSS layout with TeX math islands plus LaTeX export from the same worksheet JSON
Generator artifact documents deterministic coherent question generation from seed, constraints, variables, answers, worked solutions, and verification
Artifacts include concrete next implementation paths tied to likely repo directories
notes: Do not add npm dependencies or implement PDF compilation. Keep JSON as the source of truth.
